services.name: Daytime Manta Encounter and Whale Watch
services.desc: Tour Description: The Kona manta ray population is one of the most well-known populations in the world. While the manta ray night dive is on the top of most people’s list, why not try a natural daytime encounter. These rays frequent our winter current lines and our local manta expert provides the best likelihood to successfully locate them. Manta rays feed on plankton and are often seen feeding in current lines during early morning hours and they also frequent cleaning stations along our beautiful reefs. Manta Rays have no teeth, barbs, or stingers and are harmless to humans. Your charter Adult $152, Child $107 · 4hr Experience · 7:30am - 11:30am

services.name: Afternoon Kealakekua Bay Snorkel
services.desc: Tour Description: We’ll depart Honokohau Harbor and head south to world famous Kealakekua Bay. Once there we’ll provide everything you need for an amazing experience with our tropical reef dwellers. (And we might even run into the resident Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins!). Our guides will teach you everything you need to know about snorkeling technique and safety. We’ll even help you identify all the tropical fish you see. We’ll enjoy some light refreshments and snacks before heading back to the harbor while searching for any local marine life that may be out to play. Please note, check in is at Adult $151, Child $107 · 1:30pm - 4:30pm

services.name: Whale Watching Tours
services.desc: Tour Description >Every year more than 20,000 Humpback Whales return to Hawaii for breeding season and we’re lucky enough to enjoy their company. We’ll depart Honokohau Harbor aboard Hoku Elima in search of these majestic creatures. Our captains will be in constant contact with not only other vessels but also our spotters on shore to ensure we find you the best experience possible. While on board we’ll have light snacks and refreshments for you to enjoy while watching the whales do their thing. services.name: K-Bay Reef Snorkel and Dolphin Encounter
services.desc: Tour Description: Meet us at Honokohau Harbor and get ready for a day you will never forget! With over 20 years combined experience, our Captain and Crew are ready to educate you about the wildlife we see and answer any questions you may have. We depart the harbor heading south to the world-famous Kealakekua Bay and along the way we will look for Hawaiian spinner dolphins and other marine animals. Wild Hawaiian Spinner Dolphins often rest along our coastline during the day and are frequently visible from the boat. services.name: Kona BIG 5 Ocean Safari
services.desc: Tour Description: Kona is renowned for the crystal clear waters and diverse wild life. We are fortunate to be located, quite literally, next door to Mauna Loa, the “largest mountain” in the world and this creates the Kona coast pelagic zone which is populated with amazing coastal and large oceanic wildlife within miles of our coastline. All this is due to, Mauna Loa’s gradual slope to the sea floor.
